name: smwpatches-kirby-styled-running
title: Kirby-styled Running
description:
AKA Forward+forward running (or double tap running). This patch makes Mario run by pressing forward twice instead of pressing X/Y.
Comes with a couple of defines for keeping X/Y functionality, letting the player use both methods for running, and another couple for fixing cutscenes and demos if needed.

Features/quirks:
  • When Mario starts to run he leaves a small dust trail and a customizable SFX is played.
  • After starting to run, Mario won't stop running until his speed is 0 and both left and right are not being pressed.
  • Flight is now cancelled by pressing down instead of letting go of X/Y (this is always the case even if you have X/Y functionality enabled).
  • Mario gets a small forward boost if he starts running while standing still or while having very low speed.
  • If you have X/Y functionality disabled, Mario can carry objects and perform attacks without having to run.
  • Both running methods do not stack, if you double tap and then press X/Y, Mario will stop running when X/Y is let go.
